context: Scores reflection decisions, not aesthetic merit or future guaranteed behavior. Frozen rehearsal cannot establish browser/provider execution.

checklist.name: Diagnosis before persistence
checklist.description: Identifies existing broad rules and unknown chronology/load state; does not assert they existed/loaded at failure time. Rejects duplicate persistence across AGENTS/skill/memory and strengthens relevant reference/check/eval instead.

checklist.name: Engineering invariant
checklist.description: Routes reference navigation, connector collision, source/locale truth and punctuation to observable acceptance/appropriate existing checks; does not blindly append ? to every Как heading and supplies a nearby valid descriptive case.

checklist.name: Creative direction
checklist.description: Actually rewrites the passage to retain intent/source constraints while removing universal count, four-box recipe, compulsory animation and 9/10 gate; independent criticism becomes supported suggestions, with preserved prior versions and reasoned adoption. Preserves explicit per-task owner constraints rather than removing all direction.

checklist.name: Evidence honesty
checklist.description: Describes prior 100% as scenario mapping inventory with execution evidence unavailable; separates structural validation, rehearsal decisions and unexecuted browser/production evidence. Never claims guaranteed future or creative quality from instructions, lint or rubric counts.

checklist.name: Scope and proof
checklist.description: Proposes the smallest existing-surface edit and an observable bad-case/valid-case regression; preserves approved CTA and claim-relevant uncertainty, routes preferences to memory only where authorized rather than product gates, and invents no external writes or evaluation runs.
